details.s: Aegnor was a Ñoldorin Elf, the third son of Finarfin, elder brother of Galadriel, younger brother of Finrod Felagund and Angrod and lord of the Ñoldor of Dorthonion in the First Age.
f: Ñoldor (House of Finarfin), Falmari (House of Olwë)
YT ? during the Noontide of Valinor
